summary: Independent maintainer-style source review accepts the complete original OSS-001 criterion: the intended maintained-fork/upstream relationship and original MIT attribution are preserved, module and integration ownership are explicit, the standing branch/PR merge strategy is consistent, and release maintenance retains the authoritative scope, evidence, version and publication rules. It does not attest an upstream contribution agreement, upstream acceptance of this fork's changes, legal clearance, provider/product feature claims or commercial comparisons in the README. It does not establish live branch protection/environment reviewers, actual deployment or future exact-main CI. Root must still integrate the review/eligibility and obtain the required exact-main acceptance and closure audit. No code, workflow, licence, external repository, Git remote or release policy was mutated by this review.
